items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 15 at 4:14PM CST until November 16 at 12:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.description:
* WHAT...Minor coastal flooding and high risk of rip currents.

* WHERE...Gulf-facing beaches, including the Matagorda
Peninsula, Brazoria County beaches, Galveston Island and the
Bolivar Peninsula.

* WHEN...Until noon CST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only isolated
road closures expected. Minor coastal flooding is expected along
the low lying areas from the Bolivar Peninsula to Surfside
around high tide times today into Monday.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 15 at 11:03AM CST until November 16 at 12:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.description:
* WHAT...East to northeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 40-45
mph expected.

* WHERE...Bolivar Peninsula, Brazoria Islands, Galveston Island, and
Matagorda Islands Counties.

* WHEN...Until noon CST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued November 15 at 11:08AM CST until November 16 at 3:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 45 kt and seas
8 to 13 ft.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20
NM and Waters from High Island to Freeport TX from 20 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM CST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Heavy showers and thunderstorms likely
today. Cannot rule out locally higher winds and waterspouts.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
